correctness.rationale: Complete symbolic proof via Apéry coordinates. At F=3m+r one coordinate is forced to four. For r=1 complementary Kunz pairs have sum >=3; for r=2 coordinate one is >=2 and complementary pairs have sum >=3. Summing disjoint pairs gives the sharp genus lower bound; equality gives independent binary choices. Checking every remaining Kunz inequality proves existence, correct m,F and exhaustiveness. The script independently exhausts both lines through m=11, verifying exact minimizer sets and semigroup closure; finite checks do not replace the proof.
